thread:
mira: Heads-up — planning a preemptive maintenance window for us-east1 tonight 00:00–01:30 UTC. Goal: roll kernel micropatch, apply NIC QoS tweak, and perform bandwidth-shedding test + kv cache re-seed.
sam: ETA looks ok. Which pools are in scope?
mira: primary GPU pools: saturn-us-east1-a/b; interruptible pools + a couple of dedicated backfill racks. Not touching dedicated prod-commit pools.
kai: are we doing node drains or just soft-shutdowns? we should avoid cold KV cache hits — that'll tank latency.
mira: soft drains with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60` on cohort nodes. We'll run KV priming script after each cohort: `scripts/kv_seed --region us-east1 --cohort $COHORT`.
oncall-bot: Incident process note: oncall duty (jack) will be paged for PG2 anomalies.
jack: oncall ack. I'll be available for the window.
amy: cost note — if we push traffic to fallback region (us-west), we may spike cross-region egress. Estimate ~120TB * $0.02 = ~$2.4k for worst-case. Can we minimize routing to avoid that?
mira: plan is prefer local fallback model variants (smaller quantized instances) and only spill over to us-west as last resort. We'll also throttle batch sizes for latency-sensitive routes.
sam: also add a temporary routing rule that prefers smaller-llm-qa model in the same region: `route policy add fallback:small-llm@us-east1 priority=low`.
kai: will schedule canary cohort (5 nodes) at 00:00, monitor for 10m, then stagger remaining cohorts in 15m increments.
mira: rollback plan: if errors > 1% or GPU OOM spikes, abort and run `uncordon` + rollback NIC qdisc change. Also have automatic fallback to hosted-api-tier route.
amy: also check reserved capacity commitments — we shouldn't consume committed slots in other regions; tag fallback traffic as non-billing where possible.
jack: runbook check: health checks = per-model p99 latency, token error-rate, queue length. I'll post thresholds to PagerDuty rule.
kai: small checklist before canary: 1) update dns ttl to 30s, 2) push routing policy, 3) pre-seed KV, 4) drain canary nodes.
mira: i'll kick off pre-seed at 23:45 UTC to warm caches. will post progress here.
sam: perf test command for pre-seed validation: `perf/runner --model small-llm --qps 10 --duration 120`.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: patch 'nic-qos-v1.2' scheduled at 00:05 UTC (author: infra-auto)
jack: will monitor logs: `elk query 'us-east1 OR cohort' --since 1h`
amy: one more ask — notify a sample of customers (enterprise contacts) about potential latency blips. product/comms?
mira: product pinged in #product — they asked for a single-line blurb; i sent: "Planned infra maintenance in us-east1 00:00–01:30 UTC; minimal customer impact expected."
product: :thumbsup: 
sam: after first full cohort, run a short e2e (end-to-end) smoke: `smoke/e2e_check --workload chat --model small-llm`.
kai: note: kv-seed uses ephemeral GPU nodes; ensure they don't collide with preemption schedule.
mira: noted — will mark kv-seed nodes as non-preemptible for that 30m.
jack: escalation contacts: infra-oncall, eng-sre lead, platform-ops. I have them in PD rotation.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Maintain SLO alert suppressions during maintenance window where appropriate.
amy: ok on costs — i'll monitor egress spend during the window and report if > $500.
mira: thanks all. Will start warm-seed logs at 23:45 and post the canary start here. :eyes: 
sam: good luck. ping if you need an extra hand.
kai: ready for the canary.
jack: oncall standing by.
product: leaving thread open for comms updates.
